claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemSpawnedCreatureMechanics.catalog_ref_companion_source
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item-side spawned-creature family exists, but it currently requires an inline stat block. This collection mostly references existing creatures by name instead, so the surface needs a catalog-ref companion source rather than duplicated inline blocks.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the figurine becomes a living creature specified in the figurine's description

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.spawned_form_active_or_mounted_on_spawned_form
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Several variant riders only apply while the figurine is currently in creature form, or while the user is riding that creature. Current passive/composite item mechanics cannot scope grants and ongoing effects to that state honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While you ride the goat, any Hostile creature that starts its turn within a 30-foot Emanation originating from the goat must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw

claude_proposed_widenings.name: PassiveOperation.elapsed_time_while_active_charge_drain
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Goat of Traveling drains charges for each hour or portion thereof spent in goat form. Current resources support activation-time spending and reset cadences, but not upkeep-style drain while a spawned form remains active.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: each hour or portion thereof it spends in goat form costs 1 charge
